name: Trung Khanh chestnut
summary: Trùng Khánh chestnut is an even, nearly round autumn nut with a dark glossy shell and a yellow kernel. Roasted, it is nutty, sweet, and aromatic.
origin: Trung Khanh, on the eastern road.
howToEat: Eat it roasted or boiled on the eastern road in autumn, and buy a bag as a gift to carry home. The same nut goes into chestnut green rice, ham hock stew, and chestnut wine.
where: Trung Khanh and the eastern road, in autumn.
seoTitle: Trung Khanh chestnut — Cao Bang in autumn
